opening.learner_doing: arrives with a suitcase, an envelope and a key

arrival.visual: Evening outside the station. Learner seen from behind on the wet pavement, suitcase at their side, an envelope tucked under one arm and a key in hand; station lights, taxis and blurred commuters; steam and reflections on cobbles; a streetlamp casts a warm halo.
arrival.caption_fr: La bruine te trouve à 19:30 devant la gare de l'Est; tu tiens une valise, une enveloppe et une clé.
arrival.caption_native: Der Nieselregen trifft dich um 19:30 vor dem Gare de l'Est; du hast einen Koffer, einen Umschlag und einen Schlüssel.

room.visual: Interior of Le Mistral as the door opens. Learner seen from behind entering; warm amber light, steam from cups, rain-spattered window. Gus on a stool mid-anecdote, Marin at a small table reading aloud from a folded paper, Lila leaned on the counter smiling, Margaux behind the zinc pausing with a towel in her hand.
room.caption_fr: Le Mistral t'accueille; il est 19:35, l'air est chaud.
room.caption_native: Le Mistral empfängt dich; es ist 19:35, die Luft ist warm.

lines.text_fr: Hier je jouais dans la rue.
lines.text_native: Gestern spielte ich auf der Straße.

lines.text_fr: Ma grand-mère dit: ris si tu peux.
lines.text_native: Meine Großmutter sagt: Lach, wenn du kannst.

lines.text_fr: Ah, scène improvisée ce soir?
Un verre rapide.

opening.learner_doing: arriving in Paris with a suitcase, an official envelope and an old key; pausing on the quai to photograph the red neon for someone at home

arrival.visual: The learner seen from behind on the quai, suitcase by their side, phone held up toward the red neon across the canal; wet cobbles reflecting the warm glow; streetlamps just lit; no people in frame except the learner; evening light soft and humid.
arrival.caption_fr: Mercredi 11 novembre, 19:50, douceur. La lumière rouge du quai t'appelle; tu la captures pour quelqu'un.

room.visual: Interior of Le Mistral seen from the doorway as the learner enters (learner seen from behind in the threshold). The four regulars sit at the zinc and a corner table: augustin_de_roncourt is mid-gesture as if performing a trick, marin_leveque cradles a small bowl and listens kindly, lila_bonnet leans forward with a teasing smile, margaux_barman polishes a glass with few movements. Warm, yellow café light; steam from a bowl; rain-slick street visible through the open door.
room.caption_fr: La douceur de la soirée trouve la salle; l'heure glisse en conversations.

lines.text_fr: Je dis trois fromages que personne ne connaît, et je gagne la bouteille.
Ma grand-mère disait: un bon fromage guérit les confidences.
Tu triches, Gus — tu manges un bout sous la table, j'ai vu.
Fais vite.

spark.arrival: stopping to photograph the red neon for someone at home
spark.room: a game of who can name the most cheeses, Gus cheating

opening.learner_doing: steigt aus der Metro bei Jacques-Bonsergent, zieht den Koffer die Treppe hoch und schützt das Kuvert vor den Tropfen

arrival.visual: Learner seen from behind at the top of the metro stairs on the quai, suitcase in one hand and an envelope in the other; wind and rain blowing diagonally; sodium streetlights halo through wet air; no faces of the learner shown.
arrival.caption_fr: La pluie te trouve en montant du métro Jacques‑Bonsergent : il est 18h10, vent et gouttes frappent ta valise.

room.visual: Interior of Le Mistral at dusk, learner seen from behind in the doorway; warm counter light contrasts with wet street outside; Gus (augustin_de_roncourt) in mid-performance on a small stool with a paper prop, Marin (marin_leveque) at the corner table stirring a bowl, Lila (lila_bonnet) perched on a chair with a smirk, Margaux (margaux_barman) polishing glasses behind the zinc, all in motion but none looking at the door.

lines.text_fr: Si je dis que le duc avait tort, ça me donne des points d'originalité au quiz ?
Ma grand‑mère disait toujours : 'Un cerveau bien nourri, c'est moins de panique aux questions simples.'
Tu joues la comédie pour masquer que tu as révisé en cachette, Gus.
Vingt et une. Et pas un mot de triche.
